items.prompt: A learner removes only tokens.append(previous+str(count)) after the loop. What line would the otherwise unchanged algorithm emit for "aabb"?

options.why: The b run is never followed by a different character, so it will not be emitted without the final flush.
No remaining statement emits the b run at all. This is not a one-character counting error.
The transition from a to b emits a2. The pending b2 disappears when the final flush is removed.
Only a2 is emitted inside this loop; retaining only b2 would require a different bug.
